entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that receives messages and performs error diagnosis procedures.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: Network entity that receives messages and performs error handling procedures.

entities.name: 5GMM STATUS or 5GSM STATUS
entities.description: Status message sent in response to invalid messages, with cause #96 "invalid mandatory information".

entities.name: Imperative message part error
entities.description: Error condition diagnosed when an imperative message part error is detected.

entities.name: Missing mandatory IE error
entities.description: Error condition diagnosed when a mandatory information element is missing.

entities.name: Syntactically incorrect mandatory IE
entities.description: Error condition when a mandatory IE is syntactically incorrect.

entities.name: Unknown IE with comprehension required
entities.description: Error condition when an unknown IE encoded as comprehension required is received.

entities.name: Out of sequence IE with comprehension required
entities.description: Error condition when an out of sequence IE encoded as comprehension required is received.

entities.name: Cause #96 invalid mandatory information
entities.description: Cause value indicating invalid mandatory information in status messages.

relations.description: UE diagnoses imperative message part error condition.
UE diagnoses missing mandatory IE error condition.
UE diagnoses syntactically incorrect mandatory IE condition.
UE diagnoses unknown IE with comprehension required condition.
UE diagnoses out of sequence IE with comprehension required condition.
UE sends status message when error conditions are met and message is not in exception list.
Network may send status message when error conditions are met and message is not in exception list.
Status message contains cause #96 invalid mandatory information.
